# The Oaths
This feature is: [color=orange]In-Progress[/color].
In the world of Oathlord, oaths are beliefs that the living folk pray to, and are led by entities called "Idols". It is not known where each Idol is located, but they do exist, and you may meet them some day...
The Oathlord, a mysterious entity, is the one behind keeping the order between the Oaths.
Is it a person? An item? Or, maybe a concept? No one really knows.
## Selecting your Oath
You can select the oath of your choice in the character customization screen, via the Oaths tab. A lot of oaths have in-world benefits, which are usually explained in the description of them.
## How to Swap Oaths
So, you're in-round and you want to swap oaths. Well, this is gonna be a little hard, but certainly possible. The first thing you have to do is find the "avatar" of the oath you want to believe to. Usually, it is a statue.
Right-click on it to bring up the context menu, and click "Pray to Avatar".
Unless you are Oathless, praying to a new Oath will cause you to get cursed by the previous Oath. So, do be careful before committing to it.
## How many Oaths is there?
A lot. Some of them are not available through character customization, but only in-world. And there's also the Exiled Oaths, but those are a talk for another time...
